description: Commodity and specialty vinyls: Polyethylene (PE), Polypropylene (PP), Polystyrene (PS), PVC, PMMA, PTFE
Degradable and bio-based polyesters: Poly(lactic acid) (PLA), PCL, PLGA, PET, polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHA)
Naturally occurring polymer systems: Cellulose, Chitin, Chitosan, Alginate, Hyaluronic acid, Natural rubber
Biohybrid macromolecules, DNA/RNA polymers, synthetic polypeptides, polymer-protein therapeutic conjugates
Living radical methods: ATRP, RAFT, NMP, photo-induced living polymerization, precise sequence control
Living ring-opening: ROP of lactones/lactides, ROMP with Grubbs catalysts, CROP of cyclic imino ethers
Environmentally adaptable polymers: Thermoresponsive (LCST/UCST), pH, redox/ROS, light, and multi-responsive
Chemical and physical network hydrogels, injectable matrices, 3D bio-printing, tissue engineering scaffolds
Electroactive polymers: PEDOT:PSS, Polyaniline, Polythiophenes, organic photovoltaics, bioelectronics
Solid polymer electrolytes (SPEs), single-ion conducting polymers, gel electrolytes for lithium/sodium batteries
Targeted drug delivery, polymeric micelles, gene delivery polyplexes, stealth polymer coatings (PEG, POx)
Complex architectures: Block, graft, star polymers, hyperbranched macromolecules, dendrimers, polymer brushes
Fundamental physics: Chain conformations, melt rheology, crystallization kinetics, phase separation, scattering
Reinforced polymeric systems: Carbon nanotube, graphene, silica, and cellulose nanofiber composites
Circular polymer chemistry: Chemical depolymerization, enzymatic degradation, covalent adaptable networks (CANs)
Permeation and sieving: Desalination membranes, gas separation, organic solvent nanofiltration, fuel cell PEMs
Dynamic non-covalent interactions: Hydrogen bonding networks, host-guest complexes, autonomic self-healing
In silico simulations: Coarse-grained molecular dynamics, DFT transition states, machine learning polymer property prediction
